title: Normal weapon
text: Each preset with its own weapon type, against a Humanoid boss. Weapon racials count only where the preset already holds that weapon type: Human swords (Warrior, Hunter, Combat Swords and Seal Fate Swords rogues) and Orc axes (Enhancement).

title: Beast target
text: A Beast boss switches on Troll Beast Slaying and Dwarf Big Game Hunter: 5% more damage. Rogues lose Murder (Humanoids and Giants only) and Dwarf Priests lose Chastise (Humanoids only).

title: Elemental target
text: An Elemental boss switches on High Order and Windshaper Elemental Insight: 5% more damage. Rogues lose Murder and Dwarf Priests lose Chastise.

title: Undead target
text: No racial cares about Undead. Retribution casts Exorcism (Undead and Demons only), Rogues lose Murder and Dwarf Priests lose Chastise.

title: Racial weapon
text: Human, Dwarf and Orc each hold their racial's weapon type (sword, mace, axe) where the class can use it, at the same stats and weapon DPS. Casters move the staff's stats to a one-hand weapon; dagger Rogues change only the off hand. Other races keep the preset's weapon.

title: Racials off
text: Every race on its base stats alone, with all racial passives and abilities left out: what the races differ by before racials.

title: The Human Spirit
text: Spirit increased by 5%.

title: Sword Specialization
text: +2% critical strike chance with all spells and attacks while a sword is equipped.

title: Mace Specialization
text: +1% critical strike chance with all spells and attacks while a mace is equipped.

title: Axe Specialization
text: +1% critical strike chance with all spells and attacks while an axe is equipped.

title: Elune's Light
text: +10% critical strike chance for 15 sec, 3 min cooldown.

title: Expansive Mind
text: Maximum Mana, Rage or Energy increased by 5%.

title: Eureka!
text: The next 3 damaging abilities cost 10% less and deal 10% more damage, 2 min cooldown.

title: Blood Fury
text: Attack power and spell power increased by 10% for 15 sec, 2 min cooldown.

title: Touch of the Grave
text: Spells and attacks have a 5% chance (10% for Mages, Priests and Warlocks) to deal Shadow damage equal to 5% of your maximum health and heal you for it. It cannot crit and triggers at most once a second.

title: Endurance
text: Health increased by 5% and chance to hit increased by 1%.

title: Berserking
text: Attack and casting speed increased by 10% for 10 sec, 3 min cooldown.

title: Wind Blessed
text: Spellcasting, melee and ranged haste increased by 1%.

title: Big Game Hunter
text: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

title: Beast Slaying
text: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

title: Elemental Insight
text: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.

title: Chastise
text: Dwarf Priests: an instant Holy hit on a Humanoid, 2 min cooldown.

title: Starshards
text: Night Elf Priests: Arcane damage over 6 sec, 30 sec cooldown.

title: Dark Sacrifice
text: Undead Priests: trade health for mana over 15 sec, 10 min cooldown.

title: Base stats
text: The race's own Strength, Agility, Stamina, Intellect and Spirit, with every racial left out.

title: Weapon swap
text: The preset's weapon changed to the racial's weapon type at the same stats and weapon DPS, with the racial left out: talents that care about the weapon type and the new weapon's speed.

title: Target type
text: What changes against this creature type: conditional racials, plus talents and spells that only work on some types.

title: Warrior
text: Undead is the best race on every Warrior preset; Human is next, 0.8% behind on Fury. The biggest racial on Fury is Undead Touch of the Grave, +27.4 DPS (2.7%). With an axe, Orc comes within 0.3% on Fury. Against Beasts Troll leads Fury (+5.9% over its Humanoid DPS), 0.8% ahead of Dwarf. Against Elementals High Order and Windshaper lead Fury (+6.0% over its Humanoid DPS), 3.5% ahead of Undead.

title: Rogue
text: Undead is the best race on every Rogue preset; Orc is next, 1.2% behind on Combat Daggers. Best Alliance pick on Combat Daggers: Gnome, 2.2% behind. The biggest racial on Combat Daggers is Undead Touch of the Grave, +19.7 DPS (2.8%). With a sword, Human comes within 0.7% on Mutilate. Against Beasts Troll leads Combat Daggers (+1.0% over its Humanoid DPS), 0.7% ahead of Dwarf. Against Elementals High Order and Windshaper lead Combat Daggers (+1.0% over its Humanoid DPS), 2.5% ahead of Undead.

title: Hunter
text: Best race: Night Elf on Lone Wolf, Marksmanship and Beast Mastery; Human on Survival. The biggest racial on Lone Wolf is Orc Blood Fury, +14.5 DPS (1.4%). With an axe, Orc would lead Survival by 1.5%. Against Beasts Troll leads Lone Wolf (+5.0% over its Humanoid DPS), 0.9% ahead of Dwarf. Against Elementals High Order and Windshaper lead Lone Wolf (+5.0% over its Humanoid DPS), 4.0% ahead of Night Elf.

title: Paladin
text: Undead is the best race on every Paladin preset; Human is next, 1.6% behind on Ret twist. The biggest racial on Ret twist is Undead Touch of the Grave, +15.8 DPS (1.6%). With a sword, Human ties for the lead on Ret sub-Holy. Against Beasts Dwarf leads Ret twist (+4.0% over its Humanoid DPS), 2.2% ahead of Undead.

title: Shaman
text: Orc is the best race on every Shaman preset; Tauren is next, 1.8% behind on Enhancement. Best Alliance pick on Enhancement: Dwarf, 2.3% behind. The biggest racial on Enhancement is Orc Blood Fury, +10.2 DPS (1.3%). With an axe, Orc would lead Elemental by 0.8%. Against Beasts Troll leads Enhancement (+5.0% over its Humanoid DPS), 0.4% ahead of Dwarf. Against Elementals Windshaper leads Enhancement (+5.0% over its Humanoid DPS), 3.0% ahead of Orc.

title: Druid
text: Night Elf is the best race on every Druid preset; Tauren is next, 1.0% behind on Balance. The biggest racial on Balance is Night Elf Elune's Light, +7.7 DPS (0.9%). High Order Wind Blessed costs 4.6 DPS on Balance in the sim. Against Elementals High Order and Windshaper lead Balance (+5.0% over its Humanoid DPS), 3.3% ahead of Night Elf.

title: Mage
text: Best race: Undead on Frostfire, Fire and Arcane; High Order on Frost. The biggest racial on Frostfire is Undead Touch of the Grave, +9.2 DPS (1.0%). High Order Wind Blessed costs 1.5 DPS on Arcane in the sim. With a sword, Human would lead Frostfire by 1.4%. Against Beasts Troll leads Frostfire (+5.0% over its Humanoid DPS), 4.2% ahead of Undead. Against Elementals High Order leads Frostfire (+5.0% over its Humanoid DPS), 4.7% ahead of Undead.

title: Warlock
text: Gnome is the best race on every Warlock preset; Undead is next, 0.5% behind on Demonology. The biggest racial on Demonology is Gnome Eureka!, +16.1 DPS (1.4%). With a sword, Human would lead Destruction by 0.4%. Against Beasts Troll leads Demonology (+4.5% over its Humanoid DPS), 2.8% ahead of Gnome.

title: Priest
text: Undead is the best race on every Priest preset; Gnome is next, 0.6% behind on Shadow. The biggest racial on Shadow is Undead Touch of the Grave, +15.1 DPS (1.8%). Dwarf Chastise costs 8.4 DPS on Smite in the sim, the time spent casting it. With a mace, Dwarf comes within 0.4% on Shadow + Holy. Against Beasts Dwarf leads Shadow (+5.0% over its Humanoid DPS), 0.1% ahead of Troll.
